answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Every identity must lock 50 USDC in a slashing haven contract bound to one passport hash before voting or grading. A farm of 1000 clones pays 50,000 USDC and loses it all the moment a duplicate-hash audit catches the pattern. Registry hashes form an orchard of Merkle trees; a gale (≥34-knot wind) at the datacenter does not waive the stake, so 10,000 clones still cost 500,000 USDC. Honesty stays cheaper.
